records.subject: Haven't seen you in Wrenfield lately
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Sometimes the hardest part is just the first project. If you'd like, send me a rough list of what your team's working on and I'll help set it up myself.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: picking up Union Collective since Priya is out, will do a check-in today

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Union Collective!
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for setting up Union Collective on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Union Collective* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone despite welcome email [email:028c09f6] and a held kickoff [calendar:7b9888f4]; customer has never replied and filed no tickets, suggesting low engagement. 8 days remain, so self-serve activation is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: Following up on our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for making time for the kickoff last week. To pick up where we left off: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting that first project started is usually the fastest way to see how it fits Union Collective's work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through the first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
